title: 第21章 我去你不早说三更求月票第22章 诸国天骄榜
content_zh:
演武场中，二人心中已然发狠！
此刻面对淬体境的叶离，若是不拼尽全力，最后的结果只能和卢岳一样。
根据冯越所说的第三种方法。
淬体武者虽然以身为甲，气力不竭则血甲不褪！
但人身九窍，却是寻常武者难以护持的！
像是眼耳口鼻菊马这带孔九窍，皆有或大或小的罩门！
尤其是双目！
哪怕闭目后，眼皮卸去8成力量，击打后也极易致盲。
念头闪动间，二人身躯在半空诡异地一扭！
高旭右拳变指，食指骨节凸起如毒蛇之牙，阴狠毒辣地戳向叶离左目！
常顷则屈肘如凿，裹挟全身余力，狠狠撞向叶离右耳！
面对二人的武魂融合技，叶离的反击却比他们更快更猛！
仅是瞬间！
高旭拳头还没挥出，叶离已然跃起，双腿竟如巨蟒般瞬间绞缠上高旭脖颈！
而在另一侧，常顷眼前，一张笑脸映入眼帘！
那是叶离温和的微笑，随之……
咔嚓！
伴随着牙酸的骨骼碎裂声，叶离掌中的常顷手腕已然被腕力握地粉碎。
痛感还未从手臂蔓延，叶离的身躯就在半空中发生一个180度的拧转。
眨眼间，天旋地转！

剧烈失重感传来！犹如天地倾覆！
在二人收缩的瞳孔里，两颗太阳映入眼帘！似是金乌坠日！
不，不是太阳落下！
而是他们的身躯被挂在半空中！
叶离身躯倒转间，强自带动二人身躯。
强大的离心力下，两人固定的身躯在旋转后被掷向地面！
轰！轰！
尘土飞扬，二人埋入土中！
常顷扭曲的手腕呈现诡异的九十度。
高旭则如烂泥般瘫软在地，脊椎遭受重创。
叶离稳稳落地，甩去指尖沾染的血珠。
格挡展示手法，挨打暴露坦度！
手法和坦度展现以后，就是淋漓尽致的出手表现力度！
content_en:
In the martial arts arena, the two of them were already furious!
Facing Ye Li in the Body Tempering Realm at this moment, if he didn't try his best, the final result would be the same as Lu Yue's.
According to the third method mentioned by Feng Yue.
Although the body-tempering warrior wears body armor, his blood armor will never fade if his energy is not exhausted!
But the nine orifices of the human body are difficult for ordinary warriors to protect!
Like the eyes, ears, mouth, nose, chrysanthemum, and nine orifices, all of which have large or small covers!
Especially the eyes!
Even if you close your eyes, the eyelids will lose 80% of their power and can easily cause blindness after being hit.
As their thoughts flashed, their bodies twisted strangely in mid-air!
Gao Xu's right fist changed into a finger, and the joint of his index finger protruded like a poisonous snake's tooth, viciously poking at Ye Li's left eye!
In a moment, he bent his elbow like a chisel, used all the remaining strength of his body, and slammed into Ye Li's right ear!
Facing the two soul fusion skills, Ye Li's counterattack was faster and more fierce than them!
Just a moment!
Before Gao Xu could swing out his fist, Ye Li had already jumped up, and his legs instantly wrapped around Gao Xu's neck like a giant python!
On the other side, before Chang Qing's eyes, a smiling face came into view!
That was Ye Li's gentle smile, and then...
Click!
Accompanied by the sound of teeth breaking and bones breaking, Chang Qing's wrist in Ye Li's palm was shattered by the force of his wrist.
Before the pain spread from his arm, Ye Li's body twisted 180 degrees in mid-air.
In the blink of an eye, the world is spinning!
A severe feeling of weightlessness came! It’s like the heaven and earth are overturned!
In their shrinking pupils, two suns came into view! It seems like a golden crow falling into the sun!
No, not the sun setting!
Instead, their bodies were hung in mid-air!
When Ye Li's body was turned upside down, he forced himself to move the two bodies.
Under the powerful centrifugal force, the two fixed bodies were thrown to the ground after spinning!
boom! boom!
The dust flew up and the two of them were buried in the earth!
Changqing's twisted wrist showed a strange ninety-degree angle.
Gao Xu collapsed on the ground like mud, with his spine severely injured.
Ye Li landed firmly on the ground and shook off the blood drops stained on his fingertips.
Blocking shows off skills, getting beaten reveals frankness!
After the technique and frankness are demonstrated, it is the most vivid expression of the strength of the shot!
